info.title: Document jobs display projection addendum
info.description: The additive display response fields and safe recovery routing discriminator are documented here; this is not the complete document jobs API. Older servers may omit this projection. Recovery authority remains server-owned; recoveryKind classifies actions and recoveryPresentation selects a compatible dialog.

documentKind.description: Safe server-side producer classification. Unknown evidence is never inferred from source or jobType alone.

displayOperation.description: Display operation only. Service-record review is reserved vocabulary with no current producer; INITIAL_FINALIZATION is generate even when manualReviewRequired is true.

failureReasonCode.description: Exact stable allowlist; unknown or raw errors are null. Always null outside failed/requires_attention. This code never grants recovery authority.

recoveryPresentation.description: Safe routing hint for staff contract recovery: iframe only for generation-bound create_document; legacy for supported unbound create_document/finalize_document; null whenever recoveryKind is null (including superseded jobs). Does not expose generation, payload or authority. Older servers may omit this field: finalize can use legacy; unknown-generation create must fail closed. Backend authority checks still apply.
